name: markdown
title: Markdown
description: A Markdown string rendered from the theme's tokens and the registry's own primitives: a fenced block is a CodeBlock, a table the Table, a rule a Separator, a task item a Checkbox. GitHub-flavoured, raw HTML never rendered, URLs filtered. Optional wikilinks, and a resolveLink for links between an app's documents with the pending and broken looks built in. Web-only: no React Native half.
